headline: LL Cool J says he knocked Jamie Foxx out cold while filming Any Given Sunday On Drink Cham
body: LL Cool J says he knocked Jamie Foxx out cold while filming Any Given Sunday On Drink Champs, LL explained that Foxx asked him to ease up during a scene. LL kept playing rough, Foxx punched him in the face, and LL hit back. Foxx went down and stayed down, and LL admits he thought he was faking it. Cast members had to jump in and break it up.
